==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{ety|ru|:inh|orv:гънати<ety:inh<sla-pro:*gъnàti>>|tree=1}}
{{inh+|ru|orv|гънати}}, from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*gъnati}}, with present tense conjugation forms from {{der|ru|sla-pro|*goniti}}, related to English {{m|en|fend}}; {{m|en|defend}}; {{m|en|offend}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-гнать.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|гнать|impf|pf=погна́ть,загна́ть}}

# to [[drive]] {{gl|to forcibly cause someone or something to move}}
# to [[distill]] {{q|alcohol}}
# to [[chase]], to [[pursue]]
# {{lb|ru|colloquial}} to [[hurry]] {{+obj|ru|acc<someone>|&intransitive}}
# {{lb|ru|colloquial}} to [[fly]], to [[race]], to [[speed]] along, to [[proceed]] [[posthaste]] {{+obj|ru|acc<vehicle or horse>|&intransitive}}
# {{lb|ru|slang}} to [[lie]]
# {{lb|ru|slang}} to [[give]] {{q|used in the imperative to make a forceful demand}}

====Usage notes====
* {{U:sla:directional verb|ru|uni|impf=гнать|pf=погна́ть|othimpf=гоня́ть|othpf=погоня́ть}}

====Conjugation====
{{ru-conj|impf|5c/c|гнать|го́н|ppp=-}}
